name: Veloryn Chat Checkout
author: Veloryn

sections.description:
ChatCart Pro adds a WhatsApp checkout button to your WooCommerce store. When a customer clicks it, a WooCommerce order is created automatically and WhatsApp opens with a pre-filled order summary — including the product, variation, price, and customer details.

No API keys. No monthly fees. No third-party services beyond WhatsApp itself.

Free Version Features

  • WhatsApp button on product pages, mini-cart, and checkout — replaces or complements the standard WooCommerce buttons
  • Background order creation — a WooCommerce order is created automatically with “Processing” status before WhatsApp opens
  • Pre-filled WhatsApp message — includes product name, variation attributes (Color, Size, etc.), price, and customer info
  • Button label customization — set your own text for each button placement
  • HPOS compatible — works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Natively bilingual — ships with Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR) and English; fully translatable via .pot file

Premium Version Features

The premium version unlocks additional features:

  • WhatsApp button on the cart page
  • Floating WhatsApp button — persistent button visible on any page, with configurable position and message
  • Checkout Fields Manager — replace WooCommerce’s default form with custom fields, drag-and-drop ordering, input masks (CPF, CNPJ, CEP, SSN, VAT, phone), and CEP auto-fill via ViaCEP
  • Payment Methods — add custom payment options (PIX, boleto, bank transfer, etc.) included in the WhatsApp message
  • Number Routing — assign different WhatsApp numbers to specific product categories
  • Click Analytics Dashboard — track button clicks by type, product, and page, with date range filtering and top products leaderboard

Learn more at veloryntech.com.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • An active WhatsApp number (personal or Business)

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services. By using the plugin, data described below may be sent to these services.

WhatsApp

When a customer completes the checkout flow, they are redirected to WhatsApp with a pre-filled message containing their order summary (product name, variation, price, and customer details). This data is passed as a URL parameter to the WhatsApp redirect URL.

  • Service URL: https://wa.me / https://api.whatsapp.com
  • Privacy policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Deactivation Feedback

When a site administrator deactivates the plugin, an optional feedback form is shown. If the administrator chooses to submit the form, the selected deactivation reason and the site domain (hostname only, no paths or personal data) are sent via the site’s own email system (wp_mail) to the plugin author. Submission is entirely voluntary — the plugin can be deactivated without submitting any data by clicking “Skip & Deactivate”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the veloryn-chat-checkout folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ChatCart Pro in the admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number under the General tab and save.
  5. The WhatsApp button will appear automatically on your product pages, mini-cart, and checkout page.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin create real WooCommerce orders?

Yes. When a customer clicks the WhatsApp button, a WooCommerce order is created with “Processing” status before WhatsApp opens. You can manage it in WooCommerce > Orders.

What happens if the customer does not send the WhatsApp message?

The order is still created in WooCommerce. You can cancel it manually from the Orders panel.

Does it work with WhatsApp Business?

Yes. ChatCart Pro works with any WhatsApp number — personal or WhatsApp Business — without any API approval or monthly fees.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. The selected variation and its attributes (Color, Size, etc.) are included in the pre-filled WhatsApp message.

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes. ChatCart Pro is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme, including block-based themes.

Does the free version include buttons on the mini-cart and checkout?

Yes. The free version includes the WhatsApp button on product pages, mini-cart, and the checkout page. The cart page button is available in the premium version.

Where can I get support?

Visit support.chatcartpro.online to open a support ticket, or browse the documentation at docs.chatcartpro.online.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • Maintenance release — code quality and compatibility improvements.

3.0.0

  • Added contact channel buttons on product pages — configure WhatsApp and Instagram DM buttons independently, each with a custom label and pre-filled message
  • Added an additional floating contact button slot — place a second channel button (WhatsApp or Instagram) stacking above the main WhatsApp floating button
  • Added WhatsApp Checkout master toggle — disable the entire WA checkout flow with a single switch without losing any configuration
  • Payment Methods tab now provides step-by-step setup guidance for popular payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Authorize.net)

2.0.6

  • Security: plugin update downloads are now validated against the license key registered in the plugin

2.0.5

  • Fixed: auto-updater corrected to call the correct server endpoint — WordPress one-click updates now work correctly
  • Tested with WordPress 7.0

2.0.4

  • Static analysis (PHPStan level 5) applied across the entire codebase — stricter type checks and code quality improvements

2.0.3

  • Official Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR) translation included — the entire plugin interface is now available in Portuguese
  • Language files (.pot template + pt_BR .po/.mo) bundled in the languages/ directory

2.0.2

  • Automatic plugin updates: the plugin now appears in the WordPress dashboard update list for one-click updates
  • Fixed: “Buy via WhatsApp” button on product pages now correctly redirects to checkout after adding the product to cart
  • Fixed: WhatsApp checkout button no longer gets stuck loading on WordPress 6.7+ (jQuery 3.7.x compatibility fix)

2.0.1

  • Added Mobile Bottom Margin setting for the floating button — prevents overlap with theme navigation bars on mobile

2.0.0

  • Complete admin panel redesign with new two-column layout, green gradient header, and sidebar quick help
  • Added floating WhatsApp button — configurable fixed button that appears site-wide for general inquiries
  • Added 9 button styles to choose from
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility declaration added
  • Polylang and WPML compatibility confirmed and documented
  • All plugin prefixes unified to ccp_ / CCP_ / ccp-
  • Fully revised WhatsApp message template with more dynamic tags ({name}, {products}, {total}, {payment}, {address}, {postcode}, {notes})
  • Emojis in WhatsApp messages now encode correctly, preventing broken characters on all devices
  • Fixed: WhatsApp button appearing twice in sidebar mini-carts after fragment refresh
  • Fixed: WhatsApp button not appearing in dropdown mini-carts on the homepage
  • Fixed: variable products added via Quick View redirecting to an empty cart
  • Breaking: database options renamed from tfwc_* to ccp_* — existing v1.x settings are not automatically migrated (reconfigure after updating)
  • Breaking: all CSS classes renamed from .tfwc- to .ccp-

1.5.0

  • Variable product support: selected variation attributes (size, color, etc.) now included in the WhatsApp message
  • Button width option added (full-width or auto/inline)
  • Fixed: button appearing twice on certain themes
  • Fixed: special characters (accents) incorrectly encoded in the WhatsApp message URL
  • Fixed: cart page button not respecting quantity for variable products

1.0.0

  • Initial release
